newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippine 91-day T-bill yield rises to 10.356 pct.
newsitem.headline: Philippine 91-day T-bill yield rises to 10.356 pct.

text.p: The yield on the Philippine 91-day Treasury bill rose to 10.356 percent at Monday's weekly auction, compared to 10.293 percent last week, the Bureau of Treasury said.
The yield for six month bills was also higher at 10.597 percent from last week's 10.492 percent and on one year bills at 11.088 percent from 10.917 percent.
"The rates are market driven so we don't really know whether we have seen the bottom," Central Bank Treasurer Sergio Edeza told reporters after the auction.
Asked about whether this would have an impact on the Bank's overnight interest rates, he said he was still assessing the market.
